'''Vamilad''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Vamilad achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Active during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Vamilad survived the end of the conflict, which also heralded the end of the Republic and the Jedi Order.<ref name="IC501" />

As the Republic was reorganized into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a government that sprung up in the newly [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], Vamilad went to ground to avoid [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|execution]]. Making contact with fellow survivors such as Masters [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]], [[Plett]], and [[Iri Camas]], Vamilad agreed to shelter any Jedi survivors sent his way. Vamilad managed to seclude himself in an undisclosed location, while remnants of the Order and its allies, such as [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jilam Kester]], would lead others to safety. Though he attempted to remain under the radar of the Empire, Imperial forces were aware of Vamilad's involvement in the underground movement, but were unsure of where the Jedi was.<ref name="IC501">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
